mapper.select: SELECT id FROM audit_operation_attempt WHERE source_system=#{source} AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_attempt_outcome(attempt_id,event_ref,result_code,effect_id) VALUES(#{attemptId},CONCAT(#{attemptId},':result'),'REPLAYED', (SELECT id FROM platform_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{key.tenantId} AND actor_id=#{key.actorId} AND operation=#{key.operation} AND command_key=#{key.commandKey} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1))
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id,a.source_system,a.request_id,a.trace_id, AS action,a.actor_id, COALESCE(p.audit_resource_id,a.resource_id) AS resource_id,a.occurred_at, CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE COALESCE(o.result_code,'UNKNOWN') END AS result, o.error_code,COALESCE(p.id,o.effect_id) AS effect_id,original.audit_attempt_id AS original_attempt_id, p.audit_before_version AS before_version,p.audit_after_version AS after_version,p.audit_reason AS reason, p.audit_changes_json AS changes_json FROM audit_operation_attempt a LEFT JOIN platform_audit p ON p.audit_attempt_id=a.id LEFT JOIN audit_attempt_outcome o ON o.id=( SELECT last.id FROM audit_attempt_outcome last WHERE last.attempt_id=a.id ORDER BY last.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN platform_audit original ON original.id=o.effect_id
